lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਮਾਣਿਅਉ ਲਾਖ ਮਹਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai nirabhau maaniau laakh mahi alakh lakhaayau ||
lines.translation: In the Fear of God, You enjoy the Fearless Lord; among the thousands of beings, You see the Unseen Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਗਤਿ ਗਭੀਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪਰਚਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar gat gabheer satigur parachaayau ||
lines.translation: Through the True Guru, You have realized the state of the Inaccessible, Unfathomable, Profound Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਚੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਰਾਜ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਕਮਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parachai paravaan raaj mahi jog kamaayau ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Guru, You are certified and approved; You practice Yoga in the midst of wealth and power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਧੰਨਿ ਅਭਰ ਸਰ ਸੁਭਰ ਭਰਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dha(n)n gur dha(n)n abhar sar subhar bharaayau ||
lines.translation: Blessed, blessed, blessed is the Guru, who has filled to overflowing the pools which were empty.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗਮ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣਿ ਅਜਰੁ ਜਰਿਓ ਸਰਿ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਸਮਾਇਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur gam pramaan ajar jario sar sa(n)tokh samaaiyau ||
lines.translation: Reaching up to the certified Guru, You endure the unendurable; You are immersed in the pool of contentment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਜੋਗੁ ਨਿਜੁ ਪਾਇਯਉ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur arajun kalyucharai tai sahaj jog nij paaiyau ||8||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL: O Guru Arjun, You have intuitively attained the state of Yoga within Yourself. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਿਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਬਦਨਿ ਬਰ ਦਾਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰ ਗੁਰ ਸੂਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਿਵਾਰੵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: amiu rasanaa badan bar daat alakh apaar gur soor sabad haumai nivaary ||
lines.translation: Nectar drips from Your tongue, and Your mouth gives Blessings, O Incomprehensible and Infinite Spiritual Hero. O Guru, the Word of Your Shabad eradicates egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਚਾ ਹਰੁਨਿ ਦਲਿਅਉ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਸਹਾਰੵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)chaa harun daliau su(n)n sahaj nij ghar sahaary ||
lines.translation: You have overpowered the five enticers, and established with intuitive ease the Absolute Lord within Your own being.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਗ ਉਧਰੵਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਇਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naam laag jag udhary satigur ridai basaaiau ||
lines.translation: Attached to the Lord's Name, the world is saved; enshrine the True Guru within your heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਕਲੵੁਚਰੈ ਤੈ ਜਨਕਹ ਕਲਸੁ ਦੀਪਾਇਅਉ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: gur arajun kalyucharai tai janakah kalas deepaaiau ||9||
lines.translation: So speaks KALL: O Guru Arjun, You have illliminated the highest pinnacle of wisdom. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਰਠੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sorathe ||
lines.translation: Sorat'h

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣੁ ਪਾਰਥਉ ਚਾਲੈ ਨਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur arajun purakh pramaan paarathau chaalai nahee ||
lines.translation: : Guru Arjun is the certified Primal Person; like Arjuna, He never leaves the field of battle.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੇਜਾ ਨਾਮ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਅਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nejaa naam neesaan satigur sabad savaariau ||1||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is His spear and insignia. He is embellished with the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਸੇਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਕਾ ਬੋਹਿਥਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhavajal saair set naam haree kaa bohithaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name is the Boat, the Bridge to cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਅ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੰ ਹੇਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਜਗੁ ਉਧਰੵਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tu satigur sa(n) het naam laag jag udhary ||2||
lines.translation: You are in love with the True Guru; attached to the Naam, You have saved the world. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਇਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jagat udhaaran naam satigur tuthai paaiau ||
lines.translation: The Naam is the Saving Grace of the world; by the Pleasure of the True Guru, it is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਨਾਹਿ ਅਵਰ ਸਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ਬਾਰੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਪੜੀ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: ab naahi avar sar kaam baara(n)tar pooree paRee ||3||12||
lines.translation: Now, I am not concerned with anything else; at Your Door, I am fulfilled. ||3||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਤਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jot roop har aap guroo naanak kahaayau ||
lines.translation: The Embodiment of Light, the Lord Himself is called Guru Nanak.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਗਦੁ ਭਯਉ ਤਤ ਸਿਉ ਤਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa te a(n)gad bhayau tat siu tat milaayau ||
lines.translation: From Him, came Guru Angad; His essence was absorbed into the essence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਗਦਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਕੀਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)gad kirapaa dhaar amar satigur thir keeau ||
lines.translation: Guru Angad showed His Mercy, and established Amar Daas as the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਰਦਾਸਿ ਅਮਰਤੁ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਦੀਅਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: amaradaas amarat chhatr gur raamahi deeau ||
lines.translation: Guru Amar Daas blessed Guru Raam Daas with the umbrella of immortality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਕਹਿ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਯਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur raamadaas darasan paras kahi mathuraa a(n)mrit bayan ||
lines.translation: So speaks Mat'huraa: gazing upon the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of Guru Raam Daas, His speech became as sweet as nectar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਤਿ ਪੰਚ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਪਿਖਹੁ ਨਯਣ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: moorat pa(n)ch pramaan purakh gur arajun pikhahu nayan ||1||
lines.translation: With your eyes, see the certified Primal Person, Guru Arjun, the Fifth Manifestation of the Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਧਰਿਓ ਉਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sat roop sat naam sat sa(n)tokh dhario ur ||
lines.translation: He is the Embodiment of Truth; He has enshrined the True Name, Sat Naam, Truth and contentment within His heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਲਿਖੵਉ ਅਛਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧੁਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad purakh paratakh likhy achhar masatak dhur ||
lines.translation: From the very beginning, the Primal Being has written this destiny upon His forehead.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਜੋਤਿ ਜਗਮਗੈ ਤੇਜੁ ਭੂਅ ਮੰਡਲਿ ਛਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pragat jot jagamagai tej bhoo ma(n)dal chhaayau ||
lines.translation: His Divine Light shines forth, dazzling and radiant; His Glorious Grandeur pervades the realms of the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਪਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਹਾਯਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaras paras paras paras gur guroo kahaayau ||
lines.translation: Meeting the Guru, touching the Philosopher's Stone, He was acclaimed as Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਨਿ ਮਥੁਰਾ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਲਾਇ ਚਿਤੁ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਰਹਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhan mathuraa moorat sadaa thir laai chit sanamukh rahahu ||
lines.translation: So speaks Mat'huraa: I constantly focus my consciousness on Him; as sunmukh, I look to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਜੁਗਿ ਜਹਾਜੁ ਅਰਜੁਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸਗਲ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਲਗਿ ਬਿਤਰਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kalajug jahaaj arajun guroo sagal srist lag bitarahu ||2||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, Guru Arjun is the Boat; attached to him, the entire universe is safely carried across. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਹ ਜਨ ਜਾਚਹੁ ਜਗਤ੍ਰ ਪਰ ਜਾਨੀਅਤੁ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਰਯਨਿ ਬਾਸੁ ਜਾ ਕੋ ਹਿਤੁ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tih jan jaachahu jagatr par jaaneeat baasur rayan baas jaa ko hit naam siu ||
lines.translation: I beg from that humble being who is known all over the world, who lives in, and loves the Name, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਮ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੵੌ ਬਾਸਨਾ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਪੈ ਦੇਖੀਅਤੁ ਧਾਮ ਸਿਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: param ateet paramesur kai ra(n)g ra(n)gyau baasanaa te baahar pai dekheeat dhaam siu ||
lines.translation: He is supremely unattached, and imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord; he is free of desire, but he lives as a family man.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਰ ਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਲਾਗੵੌ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਵੰਤ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਉਰੈ ਕਾਮ ਸਿਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: apar para(n)par purakh siu prem laagyau bin bhagava(n)t ras naahee aurai kaam siu ||
lines.translation: He is dedicated to the Love of the Infinite, Limitless Primal Lord God; he has no concerns for any other pleasure, except for the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਥੁਰਾ ਕੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਮਯ ਅਰਜੁਨ ਗੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਾਇ ਰਹਿਓ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mathuraa ko prabh srab may arajun gur bhagat kai het paai rahio mil raam siu ||3||
lines.translation: Guru Arjun is the All-pervading Lord God of Mat'huraa. Devoted to His Worship, he remains attached to the Lord's Feet. ||3||
